notes: Major code SE30 (GE). Same core as SE27; the Geotechnical Engineering focus sequence appears on the diploma. Minimum 145 units plus college GE. Verified against catalog.

buckets.label: Introductory Structural Engineering
buckets.note: SE 1, SE 3, SE 9 all confirmed on both catalog and department pages.

buckets.label: Capstone / senior design
buckets.note: Geotechnical uses the Civil capstone SE 140A + 140B per catalog.

buckets.label: Technical electives
buckets.note: 3 preapproved technical electives outside the focus sequence; SE 195/197/198 not allowed.

buckets.label: General education
buckets.note: Minimum 24 units plus college GE. Engineering major GE requirement is satisfied by the student's college general-education program (each of UCSD's colleges has its own GE course set). Note states 'Minimum 24 units plus college GE', confirming this points to the college GE section rather than a fixed major-specific course list.

buckets.label: Total program units
buckets.note: Minimum 145 units. Minimum-unit total only: 145 units for the major (per file note and program summary). No course list; satisfied by cumulative units across major coursework plus college GE.
